MPhil/PhD
The Department offers postgraduate reserarch programmes leading to the degrees of Master of Philosophy (MPhil) and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) with digital enterprise technology as a major focus, in areas including robitics and automation, logistics and supply chain management, systems analytics, healthcare, Industry 4.0, Cyber-physical Systems, smart transportation, reliability, etc.

Research Achievements
Scholarships
Potential applicants are encouraged to contact Supervisors on research topics. For further information, please visit: https://www.gradsch.hku.hk/gradsch/rola/general-information-and-instructions
Major Research Areas
Supply chain management:
Advanced manufacturing, logistics engineering, financial engineering, healthcare engineering, operations engineering, system analytics and human factors engineering.
Cyber-physical systems:
Robotics, systems automation, smart devices / auto ID, simulation and virtual reality and 3D printing.
Admission Requirements
For further information, please visit: https://gradsch.hku.hk/prospective_students/application/admission_requirement
Departmental Requirements
Candidates are required to make an oral presentation of their research proposal as part of the procedure for the confirmation of candidature. Each candidate is also required to give at least one research seminar before submission of thesis title.

Departmental PhD Courses
DASE7001 Research Seminar
The course aims to provide students with a thorough understanding and training of presentation skills.
The course aims achievew the following course objectives:
To give students an in-depth understanding of the philosophy and different theories of data and systems engineering.
To introduce introduces different methodologies of data and systems engineering together with your applications in data engineering and analytics/robotics and automation/human-machine corporation.
To develop students’ abilities to give academic presentation.
Assessment
Type
Percentage of Total Assessment (%)
Course Requirement
Assignment reports
50
Attend at least 6 seminars in the field of Engineering and related subjects; in particular, at least 4 of the seminars should be within our own department.
Submit 6 seminar reports with the signatures of the supervisors and students.
Presentation
50
Each student is required to present a 15-20 minutes to introduce a piece of their work in the RPg Forum.
Students need to submit title and abstract (maximum 300 words) one month before the forum.
DASE7002 Advanced Industrial Engineering Technology
The course aims to provide students with a deeper understanding of those advance topics under the four research and development focuses. through the course, graduate students are expected to have a holistic view of the scope of these research focuses.
Assessment
Type
Percentage of Total Assessment (%)
Course Requirement
Continuous
Assessment (Assignment reports)
100
Attend 4 seminars on the four area of focuses: Industrial/Service Engineering; Systems Engineering; Intelligent Systems and Digital Enterprise Technology.
Submit 4 seminar reports with the signatures of the supervisors and students.
Scholarships
The Department offers scholarship exclusively for our qualifying Research postgraduate students, who achieved outstanding research outcomes during their studies in the Department of DASE. Eligibility and details of each scholarship vary from year to year and assessment/interviews may be required. Please contact the Department office (E-mail: [javascript protected email address]) for more information.
Chu Tsun Hong Scholarship for Outstanding Research Achievement
Research postgraduate students on the basis on the impact of their research outcomes during their studies at the Department of DASE. Research outcomes include research achievements such as publications, patents, and non-conventional research outputs.
